world.title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
world.summary: The US has removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism after 47 years, facilitating private sector investment and the country's reintegration into the global economy. This decision follows the Trump administration's acceptance of Syria's new president, Ahmed al-Sharaa, previously linked to al-Qaeda. US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announced the removal, citing significant barriers lifted.

world.title: Canada will announce retaliatory tariffs against U.S. on August 25, official say
world.summary: Canada will announce retaliatory tariffs against the United States on August 25, 2026, according to an official. This decision comes amid escalating trade tensions and a breakdown in negotiations with the Trump administration. The move marks a significant escalation in the ongoing trade dispute between the two countries, reflecting deteriorating relations and unresolved trade issues.

world.title: Canada to announce retaliatory tariffs against US after Trump warns of 'worse consequences'
world.summary: Canada plans to announce retaliatory tariffs against the United States on Tuesday, according to an official familiar with the situation. This decision follows warnings from former President Donald Trump about potential "worse consequences" related to ongoing trade tensions. The move signifies an escalation in the trade dispute between the two countries, impacting various sectors and economic relations.

business.title: Stocks in news: TCS, ICICI Bank, Hindustan Copper and Piramal Finance
business.summary: The Indian equity markets declined today, with the Nifty50 index closing just above 24,200. Traders are preparing for increased volatility due to upcoming US sanctions and the nearing expiry of monthly futures and options. Notable companies, including Tata Consultancy Services and Hindustan Copper, are in focus as they release significant corporate news impacting market dynamics.

business.title: Singtel seeks FDI approval to enter India’s satellite communications market
business.summary: Singtel is seeking Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) approval to enter India's satellite communications market. The company aims to provide satellite communication services targeting both public and private enterprises through its subsidiary, Singapore Telecom India. This move positions Singtel among global players interested in India's emerging satcom sector, which is gaining traction amid increasing demand for connectivity solutions.

business.title: Silver (XAG/USD) Price Forecast: Bullish Momentum Faces Major Resistance
business.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) is experiencing bullish momentum, but faces significant resistance from the 200-day moving average and a long-term uptrend line, which may influence its potential for a larger reversal. After closing above the 100-day moving average on Friday, silver struggled to maintain that position for a second consecutive day, indicating consolidation around potential support levels.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Unboxing Leak: What the Video Shows
technology.summary: A leaked video from Instagram account mundoelectronica.aa showcases the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, providing a detailed look at the device alongside its retail packaging. The phone features a glossy color reportedly named "Blueberry." This unboxing leak offers insights into the design and appearance of the unannounced smartphone, generating interest ahead of its official release.

technology.title: 4 Disadvantages Of Switching From Samsung To A Google Pixel Phone
technology.summary: Switching from a Samsung phone to a Google Pixel may present challenges for long-term Samsung users. Four notable disadvantages include the potential loss of certain Galaxy features, tools, and customization options. Users may miss Samsung's software enhancements, camera capabilities, user interface familiarity, and ecosystem integration. These trade-offs can impact the overall user experience when transitioning to a Pixel device.

technology.title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Geekbench run reveals Dimensity 9600 Pro's 4.55 GHz prime cores
technology.summary: Leaked benchmark data from a Vivo X500 Pro Max engineering sample indicates the Dimensity 9600 Pro features a dual-prime-core design for the first time in a flagship MediaTek chip. The eight-core setup includes two cores clocked at 4.55 GHz, three at 4.35 GHz, and three at a base frequency of 3.10 GHz, organized across three clusters.

sports.title: Maria Sharapova to Naomi Osaka: 5 athletes who are serving major fashion moments off the court
sports.summary: Modern tennis has evolved into a fashion showcase, moving beyond traditional attire. Elite players now blend athletic performance with high-end luxury, transforming tournament venues into exclusive runways. The article highlights five female athletes, including Maria Sharapova and Naomi Osaka, who excel in navigating both competitive sports and the fashion industry, embodying the intersection of sport and style.

sports.title: PSG turned down Liverpool's proposal to sign Ibrahim Mbaye and Bradley Barcola in single transfer package
sports.summary: Liverpool proposed a single transfer package to Paris Saint-Germain for the signings of Bradley Barcola, 23, and Ibrahim Mbaye, 18. However, PSG, the back-to-back UEFA Champions League winners, rejected the offer. The negotiations were reported by L’Equipe, highlighting Liverpool's interest in acquiring both players simultaneously, but PSG's decision indicates their unwillingness to proceed with the combined deal.

sports.title: NZA vs HKIA Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: New Zealand A (NZA) will compete against Hyderabad Kingsmen Academy (HKIA) in the 14th match of the Top End T20 Series 2026. The match is scheduled for 10:30 IST on August 25, 2026, at Marrara Cricket Ground No. 2 in Darwin. NZA currently ranks second in the points table with four points from previous matches.

health.title: Doctor reveals kidney disease symptoms that have nothing to do with your kidneys
health.summary: Kidney disease can develop silently over years, often without noticeable symptoms. By the time individuals experience any discomfort, the condition may be significantly advanced. Dr. Vishal Saxena, Vice-Chairman of Nephrology & Renal Transplant, emphasizes the importance of awareness regarding subtle signs that may not directly relate to kidney function, highlighting the need for early detection and intervention.

health.title: 100 days of Ebola and the race to stop the spread
health.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an unprecedented Ebola outbreak, now 100 days old, with nearly 90 confirmed cases daily, surpassing the 2018-2020 epidemic. UN agencies emphasize the need for intensified containment efforts in the eastern region and across borders. Current figures report 5,515 cases and 2,648 fatalities, highlighting the urgency of the situation.

health.title: Physical activity hasn't increased globally in 20 years
health.summary: Nine out of ten countries have set goals to boost physical activity among their populations. However, the global percentage of individuals meeting exercise recommendations has remained stagnant for 20 years. This lack of progress is attributed to insufficient political prioritization of inactivity, which poses health risks comparable to smoking. Efforts to address this issue have not gained significant traction.

science.title: Scientists develop a greener, catalyst-free, rocket thruster to power the next generation of spacecraft
science.summary: Scientists have developed a new green rocket thruster that ignites at room temperature using electricity, eliminating the need for a preheated catalyst bed. This innovative system utilizes ammonium dinitramide fuel, with an electric arc aiding in stabilizing the combustion process. The advancement aims to enhance the efficiency and environmental sustainability of future spacecraft propulsion technologies.

science.title: An Active Volcano May Be Creating a Valuable Metal Deposit Deep Underground
science.summary: An active volcano may be creating valuable metal deposits deep underground. While eruptions can cause destruction, the liquids from magma often contain important metals. Most mining of metals such as copper, zinc, and lead occurs in ancient volcanic regions. Researchers are studying these processes to understand how active volcanoes contribute to the formation of these valuable mineral resources.

science.title: NASA images reveal new lunar crater left by SpaceX upper stage
science.summary: NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter has released before-and-after images of a new crater formed by the impact of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage on the Moon. This event occurred earlier this month, providing scientists with a unique opportunity to analyze a fresh lunar impact. The images offer valuable insights into the effects of such collisions on the lunar surface.
